H14.title: Return and Volatility Forecasting Using On-Chain Flows in Cryptocurrency Markets
H14.abstract_snippet: We empirically examine the intraday return- and volatility-forecasting power of on-chain flow data for Bitcoin(BTC), Ethereum(ETH), and Tether(USDT).
